title: Eyes on Heritage Hackathon 2026
description:
Planet satellite imagery for the Eyes on Heritage Hackathon in Abu Dhabi, October, 9-17 2026. Sites include Damascus, Syria; Agadez, Niger; Aleppo, Syria; Marrakesh, Morocco; Timbuktu, Mali; Historic Cairo, Egypt; Derna, Libya; Herat, Afghanistan.
